ns2:course.label: Community Nutrition
ns2:course.description: (FSHN 328) Application and integration of the principles of nutrition and their delivery in the context of social, political, and economic environments in local, national, and international settings. Offered in alternate years. Same as NUTR 428. Prerequisite: FSHN 220 or equivalent, one introductory statistics course, and one course in the social or behavioral sciences.
